title: Ship the Windows MSI with per-user install as the default, or keep per-machine?
meta: choice · blocks: the 0.4 installer build and the agent-b packaging test
delivery: Delivered 9 min ago · not yet read
body:
The MSI currently installs per-machine, which needs an administrator prompt. Most of The team's machines are single-user, and the WiX per-user mode avoids the prompt entirely. Upgrades still work in place.

What changes: the install goes to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs instead of Program Files. Shortcuts are per-user. A machine-wide install stays available with an MSIINSTALLPERUSER=0 property for lab machines.

I tested both modes on the Windows 11 VM: clean install, upgrade from 0.3, and uninstall. Both passed. The per-user build is 2 MB smaller because it skips the service registration we don't use.
